properties.site-address: Land West of Rushenden Road, Queenborough
properties.notes: The site forms part of the Queenborough & Rushenden Masterplan and its inclusion for a Permission in Principle could undermine this process. The overall site is identified as having capacity for up to 480 dwellings, however application 16/507298/FULL was approved for 101 dwellings on the southern portion of the site and is under construction.. The site is vacant and is surrounded by Rushenden Road to the east and Queenborough Creek to the west.
